provider_treatment: Separate games; no cross-provider offers or joint competition.
recommender_information: All records of its provider, full user preference brief, exact buyer decision template and game rules. No previous runs or observed buyer feedback.
buyer_information: Private preferences, fixed request, recommender incentive and information, selected buyer-facing message, and exact returned records only. No oracle or private recommender forecasts.
recommender_objective: Maximize realized displayed purchase value, zero for decline; revenue proxy because product profit margins are unavailable.
buyer_objective: Maximize expected purchase satisfaction within $800, including seller trust and value for money.
recommender_actions: Any ordered subset of its frozen records plus accompanying text. Records cannot be modified.
buyer_actions: Any compatible subset of returned records or decline; no purchase outside list.
query_policy: Fixed initial user query; full frozen provider catalog available to recommender. No live engine calls or strategic search-query simulation in this condition.
candidate_policy: Recommender ranks at least three distinct response candidates including empty list; buyer ranks supported outcomes including decline. Unselected responses are not tested against a buyer.
horizon: One recommender move and one buyer move per provider, no iterative feedback.
prediction_status: Recommender forecasts are qualitative model judgments, not independently optimized expected-profit estimates.
